[EN] Thank the gods, we're not late!
[ES] ¡Gracias a los dioses, no llegamos tarde!

[EN] Dakuryon, I'll punish you and change my fate!
[ES] ¡Dakuryon, te castigaré y cambiaré mi destino!

[EN] I'm another you from a different world. I'll tell you everything later.
[ES] Soy otro tú de un mundo diferente. Te lo explicaré todo más tarde.

[EN] Right now, we don't have time. Please just do as I say.
[ES] Ahora mismo no tenemos tiempo. Por favor, haz lo que te digo.

[EN] I'll take everyone out of this world.
[ES] Sacaré a todos de este mundo.

[EN] Defeat Dakuryon, please!
[ES] ¡Derrota a Dakuryon, por favor!
